text: Did someone lose this? Looks like it was dropped not long ago. Must have been this morning.
I wonder who it belongs to...
I figured it must belong to someone who traveled here this morning.
It belongs to the traveler I met earlier, in a different time cycle.
Hi there! It's nice to see a friendly face on this road.
But I can handle myself. I have something special that keeps me safe.
Wear this cloak in battle, and you'll find that monsters will be somewhat less likely to attack you.
Here, you can have it. I have another one.
Oh, you already had one? That's great! I hope it serves you well.
Don't be shy, take it! I have a spare.
Pretty cool right? Take care on the road!
Dear traveler, if you'd like, I can put you to sleep among my healing flowers for 1 hour. Your wounds will mend while you rest. Would you like to accept this healing?

choices.text: *Politely decline her offer. Take your leave.*

text: Your health and energy are fully restored. Go with my blessings, traveler.
Dear traveler, if it was a bit earlier, I could have put you to sleep among my healing flowers. Your wounds would have mended while you rested.
But out here, it's hard to cultivate healing flowers, so these flowers lose their power in the evening.
If you come back some other time in the morning of afternoon, I would be happy to help you. I'm very sorry.
